notes: A first-of-kind retreat from the Welsh public sector 2030 net zero ambition, and framed by officers as sector-wide pressure rather than one council's failure. If it cascades, the public-sector delivery context behind SI6 weakens. Weak signal by design: single council, but watch for followers and for Welsh Government's response. Also tagged SI11: a public body withdrawing a climate commitment is an organisation reducing its action, which is what SI11 measures, and officers describing the pressure as sector-wide makes it a leading indicator for other bodies. Added 24 July 2026; SI11's evidence is otherwise internal, so this is an incidental external sighting rather than genuine coverage of the indicator.
summary: In July 2026 Bridgend council dropped its 2030 operational net zero target (adopted 2023) for a 'more realistic' efficiency-led strategy with a 2030 review, citing residual emissions and severe funding constraints; 72 percent of consultation respondents opposed keeping the target. Officers told scrutiny the new Welsh Government administration recognises 2030 net zero will be incredibly difficult across the public sector.
title: Bridgend council drops its 2030 net zero target as unachievable; officers say the pressure is sector-wide
